kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Taiwan briefly slows its mobile internet to text-only speed as part of defense drill
wire.summary: The drills come amid rising tensions with China, which frequently sends military planes and ships towards Taiwan.

wire.title: Inflation eased slightly in July. And, ICE plans to give officers electric shock gloves
wire.summary: Inflation cooled a bit last month, according to a new report from the Labor Department. And, ICE plans to equip its officers with electric shock gloves.

wire.title: The drug lenacapavir is a mighty weapon against HIV. Its rollout gets mixed reviews
wire.summary: It's a twice-a-year injection that is remarkably effective in preventing an HIV infection. Distribution is starting. But questions are being raised about getting it to the areas that need it most.

wire.title: Primary voters send mixed signals about what they want from the Democratic Party
wire.summary: Primary results this month in Michigan, Minnesota and Wisconsin paint a muddled picture of just how far to the left Democratic voters want their candidates to be come this fall's midterm elections.

wire.title: U.S. ambassador calls settler siege of Palestinian homes a 'horrific act of terror'
wire.summary: The U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemned the actions of Jewish settlers who are besieging the home of an American Palestinian family in the Israeli-occupied West Bank.

wire.title: Sailors and their families have lives on pause, uncertain if they'll return to Mideast
wire.summary: Sailors and family members who were evacuated from U.S. bases in the Middle East months ago are waiting for the military to figure out what will happen to the lives they left behind.

wire.title: These swing voters in Nevada say they are not dismissing socialist candidates
wire.summary: In online focus groups, 10 of 12 Biden-to-Trump voters said they wouldn't automatically think negatively of a politician who identifies with socialism.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Primary results reveal divide among Democratic Party, new inflation report could give the Fed more time to bring inflation under control, rescues teams race to find survivors of Colombia earthquake.

wire.title: New indictment alleges Nick Reiner was lying in wait before killing his parents
wire.summary: A grand jury has indicted Nick Reiner on murder charges in the killings of his parents, Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner, and adds the allegation that he was lying in wait before attacking them.

wire.title: Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century
wire.summary: As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered. It was the Spain's first total solar eclipse in more than a century.

wire.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
wire.summary: In an exclusive interview with the BBC’s Steve Rosenberg, Dmitry Muratov says the Kremlin leader can only "destroy Ukraine, not conquer it", with the war now in its fifth year.

wire.title: UK defends seizing shadow fleet tanker after Putin threat
wire.summary: The UK government says it is "disrupting and deterring shadow fleet vessels" in accordance with the law.

wire.title: More troops to be sent to West Bank village besieged by Israeli settlers
wire.summary: Two Palestinian families in the village of Qusra say they have been trapped in their homes, with water and power cut off, since Sunday.

wire.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
wire.summary: The outbreak, declared on 15 May, has caused more than 2,000 deaths, with thousands more reported cases.

wire.title: Travis Kelce shares first details from his wedding to Taylor Swift: 'Best night of my life'
wire.summary: In the comments, Kelce called Swift his "wife" for first time and said it was a "childhood dream" to wed at Madison Square Garden.

wire.title: Eurovision Song Contest 2027 to be held in Burgas, Bulgaria
wire.summary: The Black Sea location has been selected after Bulgarian singer Dara won this year's contest.
